# EXPERIMENTAL: Overture Divisions for Geocoding (ODbL)

> Overture Maps divisions, release 2026-10-21.0, as cloud-native GeoParquet and
> PMTiles for a browser geocoder. Five boundary levels from country to
> locality, each with a display-simplified companion, plus a multilingual name
> search index of 5,604,413 rows over 3,572,796 divisions. Static files on
> object storage, no API, no credentials. Produced by Overture Maps Foundation;
> this catalog republishes, it does not produce.

Public root:
https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/catalog.json

EXPERIMENTAL: the schema may change without notice and the hosting repository
is unlisted. Pin the catalog_version from
https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/names/index.json
if you depend on it.

This is a Portolan catalog, which is STAC 1.1.0 plus the Portolan profile.
Every file is readable in place over HTTPS range requests. Six collections,
each with a collection.json, a README.md for humans, an AGENTS.md for machine
clients, GeoParquet, PMTiles and four MapLibre styles.

License: ODbL-1.0, SHARE-ALIKE. A database derived from this one has to be
released under ODbL, and anything shown has to display '© OpenStreetMap
contributors. Available under the Open Database License.' The CC-BY-4.0
alternative, with no share-alike, no locality level and no multilingual names,
is https://source.coop/portolan-mirrors/geoboundaries-catalog .

This is NOT a byte-for-byte mirror. It keeps only the land polygon of each
division, excludes the neighborhood, microhood and macrohood subtypes, derives
an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, and adds display-simplified geometry, a
search index and vector tiles. Every deviation is in
https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/changes-from-upstream.md
.

## Read these first

- [Catalog agent
  guide](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/AGENTS.md):
  the collections, the join keys, and the nine traps that produce wrong
  answers.
- [Catalog
  README](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/README.md):
  what is here, which of the two catalogs to use, the license, and how a
  geocoder widget consumes it end to end.
- [Search index
  guide](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/names/AGENTS.md):
  the range-request path, multilingual lookup, and the join back to geometry.
- [Index
  manifest](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/names/index.json):
  fetch this before the index itself.
- [Changes from vanilla
  Overture](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/changes-from-upstream.md).
- [Root
  catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/catalog.json):
  the STAC entry point.

## Collections

- [country — Country and Dependency
  Boundaries](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/country/collection.json):
  level 0, 272 rows, 51.4 MB GeoParquet in 34 row groups of 8. [agent
  guide](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/country/AGENTS.md)
- [region — Region
  Boundaries](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/region/collection.json):
  level 1, 3,929 rows, 231.0 MB GeoParquet in 152 row groups of 26. [agent
  guide](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/region/AGENTS.md)
- [county — County
  Boundaries](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/county/collection.json):
  level 2, 38,937 rows, 649.4 MB GeoParquet in 406 row groups of 96. [agent
  guide](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/county/AGENTS.md)
- [localadmin — Local Administrative
  Boundaries](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/localadmin/collection.json):
  level 3, 21,502 rows, 142.6 MB GeoParquet in 90 row groups of 240. [agent
  guide](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/localadmin/AGENTS.md)
- [locality — Locality
  Boundaries](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/locality/collection.json):
  level 4, 556,094 rows, 1.2 GB GeoParquet in 580 row groups of 960. [agent
  guide](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/locality/AGENTS.md)
- [names — Multilingual Name Search
  Index](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/names/collection.json):
  5,604,413 rows (3,572,796 divisions + 2,031,617 alternative spellings), 407.7
  MB, sorted by folded name, 876 row groups of 6,400. [agent
  guide](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/names/AGENTS.md)

## Start a query

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- Everything called Kyoto, in any language, best match first.
SELECT name, name_lang, level, country, parent_name, population
FROM 'https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture/names/overture_division_names.parquet'
WHERE name_norm LIKE 'kyoto%'
ORDER BY level, population DESC NULLS LAST;
```

## The things that produce wrong answers

1. Join on `division_id`, never on `id`. Both are GERS identifiers; `id`
   belongs to the polygon and a join on it returns nothing.
2. `level` is this catalog's 0-to-4 mapping, not Overture's `admin_level`.
3. The five boundary levels do not tile the globe and do not fill gaps from a
   coarser level. The names index is the only complete view.
4. 2,952,062 divisions have no polygon anywhere here, almost all localities
   Overture publishes as a point. `has_boundary` says so per row.
5. An alternative-name row shares its division's `feature_id`. Dedupe results
   on it or the same city appears once per language.
6. The geometry is the land outline; Overture's maritime polygon is not
   carried.
7. The `*_display.parquet` files are buffered OUTWARD on purpose, so neighbours
   overlap. Draw and filter with them; measure and clip with the
   full-resolution files.
8. localadmin exists for 19 countries only. An empty result there is usually
   missing coverage, not a missing place.

## Optional

- [Overture Maps divisions
  guide](https://docs.overturemaps.org/guides/divisions): what each subtype
  means and Overture's own coverage statement.
- [Overture attribution and
  licensing](https://docs.overturemaps.org/attribution/): the exact attribution
  this catalog's license requires.
- [Overture release index](https://docs.overturemaps.org/release/latest/): the
  authoritative source, including the themes this catalog does not mirror.
- [geoboundaries-catalog](https://source.coop/portolan-mirrors/geoboundaries-catalog):
  the CC-BY-4.0 counterpart, same column contract, no share-alike, no
  localities, no multilingual names.
- [Source
  repository](https://github.com/portolan-mirrors/cn-geocoder-overture): the
  pipeline, the per-collection provenance records, the index measurements, and
  the issue tracker.
- [Portolan specification](https://github.com/portolan-sdi/portolan-spec): what
  this catalog conforms to.
